2608.01269.title: ACE-GraphRAG: Agentic Context Engineering for Hierarchical GraphRAG
2608.01269.paper_summary: Hierarchical Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) organizes corpus knowledge at multiple levels of granularity, yet fixed context construction may fail to translate these multi-resolution representations into a context suited to the current query. We identify this mismatch as the representation--inference gap. We propose Agentic Context Engineering for Hierarchical GraphRAG (ACE-GraphRAG), an inference-time context policy layer that supplements and adapts the initial context for generation. ACE-GraphRAG formulates context construction as a policy over gap-aware refinement, retrieval branches, and task-conditioned adaptation. Parallel Differential Retrieval acquires supplementary evidence from depth-oriented factual and breadth-oriented semantic branches. These evidence increments are consolidated with the initial context while preserving provenance and abstraction levels. Full-ACE applies the full policy uniformly within each task family, whereas Adaptive-ACE selects task- and topology-specific policies for individual queries. We evaluate ACE-GraphRAG on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and four UltraDomain subsets across multi-hop QA and query-focused summarization. Full-ACE outperforms the evaluated RAG and GraphRAG baselines across both task families, while Adaptive-ACE further improves multi-hop QA and is preferred over Full-ACE on all four UltraDomain subsets. Ablation and topology analyses support treating context construction as a query- and task-dependent inference policy rather than a fixed procedure.
2608.01269.paper_summary_zh: 階層圖檢索增強生成（GraphRAG）在多個粒度層次上組織語料庫知識，但固定的上下文構建可能無法將這些多分辨率表示轉換為適合當前查詢的上下文。我們將這種不匹配識別為表示-推理差距。我們提出了階層圖RAG的主動上下文工程（ACE-GraphRAG），這是一種推理時上下文策略層，用於補充和調整生成的初始上下文。ACE-GraphRAG將上下文構建公式化為一種針對差距意識的精煉、檢索分支和任務條件適應的策略。平行差異檢索從深度導向的事實分支和廣度導向的語義分支獲取補充證據。這些證據增量與初始上下文合併，同時保留來源和抽象層級。Full-ACE在每個任務系列內均勻應用完整策略，而Adaptive-ACE則為個別查詢選擇任務和拓撲特定的策略。我們在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和四個UltraDomain子集上評估ACE-GraphRAG，涵蓋多跳QA和查詢聚焦摘要。Full-ACE在兩個任務系列中均超越了評估的RAG和GraphRAG基準，而Adaptive-ACE進一步改善了多跳QA，並在所有四個UltraDomain子集中優於Full-ACE。消融和拓撲分析支持將上下文構建視為查詢和任務依賴的推理策略，而不是固定程序。
